snippet.title: RPS: The Escape | Official Gameplay Preview | Indie Card Game
snippet.description:
RPS: The Escape is a dark card game built around Rock-Paper-Scissors 

Build your hand, use powerful items, outplay your opponents and escape all rooms.

Play now on itch.io:
https://horusforgedev.itch.io/rps-the-escape

Developed by Horus Forge.

#indiegame #solodev #gamedev #itchio #cardgame
